sponsors-first.text: The United States and Japan supported extending reporting for accurate information on Houthi attacks, while Algeria abstained citing concerns over resolution implementation and misuse of self-defence.

algeria-first.text: Algeria abstained citing misuse of self-defence, while US and Japan sponsors supported extending reporting to track Houthi attacks threatening commerce and humanitarian aid.

action-first.text: Algeria's assessment of misuse in self-defence justified its abstention, while the adopted action extended reporting and reiterated demands without new military authorization.
